title: Declare a list with more than 5 items
description:
Declare a list with more than 5 items.

Python-Gym adaptation: implement as list_with_more_than_five_items(), returning a list of your own choosing that contains more than 5 items.
hints: Any list works as long as it has more than 5 elements - the exact values are up to you.
Count the items you put between the square brackets before you return them.
Return a list literal with at least 6 comma-separated items, e.g. [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6].
expected_behavior: Returns a list containing more than 5 items.
explanation: The requirement is only about the count of elements, so any list literal with 6 or more comma-separated values satisfies it.
